title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Daily Allowed Amount for Continued-Stay Days at Issue
content:
## Appeals and Grievances casebook: the daily allowed amount for the days at issue

Scope: an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration taken on a denied continued-stay request for an inpatient mental health stay.

**Rule.** The daily allowed amount used to value the days at issue is set as follows: where the highest-numbered paid day line of the stay's claim stands joined to an Allowable Charge Review opened on an earlier paid line of that claim, and the patient had a paid admission at the same facility under an earlier inpatient mental health authorization that has since expired and began within the twelve months before the stay's admission, it is that earlier admission's allowed amount divided by its covered days; where that joined review stands and there is no such admission, it is the higher of the stay's paid daily rate and the stay's billed amount per paid covered day, the latter divided for a nonparticipating facility by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit; in every other case it is the stay's paid allowed amount divided by its paid covered days; each is rounded to the cent.

The stay's paid day lines are the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines with the line outcome paid, from the facility of the stay's authorization, whose service date is the authorization's first valid day (the admission). The stay's claim is the claim number of those lines. The joined review stands when, among the patient's Allowable Charge Review records with status filed, one is on the claim's highest-numbered paid line and the claim carries at least one other filed Allowable Charge Review record, on an earlier paid line. The earlier admission is the admission under the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization at the same facility with status expired and the latest first valid day, as shown in Referrals and Authorizations; its first valid day is the admission date, and its paid lines are the patient's paid TRICARE Select lines from that facility with that service date. The earlier admission counts when it has paid covered days and fewer than 12 whole months have passed from its first day to the stay's admission (12 months is the window: an admission on 2025-03-02 counts for a stay admitted 2026-03-01 and does not for a stay admitted 2026-03-02, hypothetical dates). The stay's billed amount per paid covered day is the total billed on its paid day lines divided by their covered days; the balance-billing limit is the TRICARE Select tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit percentage.

Hypothetical stay: paid day lines allowed 6,000.00 over 8 covered days (paid daily rate 750.00), billed 7,200.00 (900.00 per day); earlier admission allowed 4,620.00 over 5 days (924.00).

- Joined review stands, earlier admission within the window: 924.00.
- Joined review stands, no such admission, participating facility: the higher of 750.00 and 900.00, which is 900.00.
- Same, nonparticipating facility with a 15 percent limit: 900.00 divided by 1.15 is 782.61, higher than 750.00, so 782.61.
- No joined review: 750.00.

| Joined review stands on the stay's claim | Earlier admission within 12 months | Daily allowed amount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the earlier admission's allowed amount per covered day |
| yes | no | the higher of the stay's paid daily rate and its billed amount per paid covered day (nonparticipating: divided by one plus the limit) |
| no | yes or no | the stay's paid allowed amount per paid covered day |
